description: TieringOffloadingSpec with no secondary tiers, whose manager forwards to its CPU primary tier: reset_cache while a store is in flight, then the request registered again, as the tiering manager requires (it drops every request's state on reset, vllm/v1/kv_offload/tiering/manager.py:1141-1199@4ba787ec): the cache starts empty at slot 0. The scheduler never completes a pre-reset job (reset_cache's own comment), so this sequence does not either. From v0.33.0 the connector calls on_reset_flushed once its workers report every job in flight at the reset (vllm/v1/kv_offload/base.py:487-490@4ba787ec), and this sequence does so straight after the reset.
